informational.text: `showChange` on `dsLineSeries` and `ds-line-chart` colours the stretch from a reading of 0 in `--ds-chart-positive-color` or `--ds-chart-negative-color` like any other stretch, and prints no percentage on it.
informational.verify: Hover the reading after a 0 on a ds-line-chart with showChange and confirm the stretch from the 0 is thickened in the rising or falling colour with no percentage above it.

informational.text: The `showChange` stretch and percentage wait `--ds-motion-chart-mark-exit-duration` and fade in over `--ds-motion-chart-mark-enter-duration` (120ms and 400ms by default), as the chart's other labels do, and leave on `--ds-motion-chart-mark-exit-duration` and `--ds-motion-chart-mark-exit-easing`.
informational.verify: Hover a reading on a ds-line-chart with showChange and confirm the percentage appears after a short pause and fades in at the pace of the column value labels.

informational.text: A `ds-table` `width: 'content'` column no longer collapses to 0px after its rows, page or fonts change while the table sits under a `display: none` ancestor such as an inactive `ds-tabs` panel; the table measures the column when it is shown.
informational.verify: Change the data of a ds-table with a width: 'content' column while its ds-tabs panel is inactive, switch back, and confirm the column fits its widest cell instead of collapsing.
